qualification.details: Only local women (female) candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised posts. Educational Qualification: Minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th pass) or its equivalent. Merit is determined by adding marks from the minimum qualifying level (Intermediate/equivalent) up to a maximum of Graduate/Postgraduate, calculated through the departmental portal as per the applicable Government Order. Residency: The applicant must be a resident of the Ward (in the case of a post in a Municipal body area) or of the Gram Panchayat (in the case of a post in a rural area) where the vacant post is located. Applications for a reserved post are valid only from candidates of that specific reserved category; applications from candidates of any caste are accepted for unreserved posts. | Widows: A death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer/concerned Nagar Nikay, or a certified copy of the family register, will be considered valid proof. Divorced/Abandoned (Parityakta) women: Only a legal order issued by the Hon'ble Court will be considered valid. Candidates must indicate their Widow/Divorced/Abandoned status in the online application form at the time of applying - no such claim will be accepted or considered later if not indicated at that stage. Income Certificate: Only an income certificate issued by the competent authority as per UP Government Revenue Section-9 order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj0-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended), verifiable online, will be considered valid. The validity of the income certificate is calculated from the date of notification publication; if the woman applicant is married, either her own or her husband's income certificate is valid. Below Poverty Line (BPL) income limit: As redetermined by Social Welfare Section-2, UP Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14.09.2015 (as amended), the prescribed income limits for rural and urban areas will be followed. Residence and Caste Certificate: Only online, digitally-signed certificates issued by the Tehsil, verifiable online, will be considered valid.

selection_process: All selection proceedings are governed by Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 (1917687) dated 17.09.2025. Selection is fully online and merit-based. Merit is determined by educational qualification - marks from the minimum qualifying level (Intermediate/equivalent) through to a maximum of Graduate/Postgraduate are computed via the departmental portal

as per the Government Order. No written examination or interview is mentioned in this notification for the selection of Anganwadi Sahayika. Any discrepancy between the details entered on the online portal and the candidate's original documents will be resolved in favour of the details recorded in the original documents.
how_to_apply: Register and fill the online application form with all required personal, educational, residency, and category details, correctly and carefully, in the format provided on the website.
Mention Widow/Divorced/Abandoned status in the application form at the time of applying, if applicable - this cannot be claimed later if not indicated at this stage.
Upload self-attested, clear and legible scanned copies of all documents mentioned in the online form.
Ensure the Residence and Caste Certificates are online, digitally-signed documents issued by the Tehsil, verifiable through the online portal.
Applications sent offline will not be accepted or considered valid under any circumstances - online submission through the portal is the only valid mode.
Submit the completed application before the last date, 08.10.2026, midnight (12:00 AM).
important_instructions: Only local women candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised Anganwadi Sahayika posts. No application sent offline will be considered valid - only the online application submitted through the portal will be accepted. All uploaded documents must be self-attested, clean, and legible copies as referenced in the online application form. If any error, incorrect data, or fabricated document/marks is found in the application, the candidature will be summarily rejected - the applicant will be solely responsible for such errors. The number of vacant posts indicated is provisional and may increase or decrease, as reflected on the website. Detailed eligibility criteria and the full application procedure are available on the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in, and further information can be obtained from the concerned Tehsil/Block Development Officer's office, Child Development Project Officer's office, or the District Programme Officer's office at Vikas Bhavan, Shahjahanpur, during office hours within the prescribed time.

faq.question: Q1. What is Shahjahanpur Anganwadi Sahayika Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notice issued by the District Programme Officer, Shahjahanpur, for filling 460 honorarium-based posts of Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) under the Child Development Projects in the district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Shahjahanpur Anganwadi Sahayika Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 460 total vacancies, distributed across 15 project areas: Banda, Bhawalkhera, Dadraul, Jaitipur, Jalalabad, Kant, Kalan, Khutar, Khudaganj, Madanapur, Mirzapur, Nigohi, Puwayan, Sindhauli, and Tilhar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Shahjahanpur Anganwadi Sahayika Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 08.10.2026, midnight (12:00 AM).

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for the Anganwadi Sahayika post?
faq.answer: Only local women candidates aged 18–35 years (as on 01.07.2026), with a minimum qualification of Intermediate (or equivalent), who are residents of the relevant Ward or Gram Panchayat, are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Shahjahanpur Anganwadi Sahayika Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years, as on the cut-off date of 01.07.2026. Only the High School marksheet/certificate is valid proof of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Anganwadi Sahayika post?
faq.answer: Selection is fully online and merit-based, determined by educational qualification percentage as calculated through the departmental portal. No written examination or interview is mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Shahjahanpur Anganwadi Sahayika Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must register and apply only through http://upanganwadibharti.in, uploading all required self-attested documents, before the closing date of 08.10.2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is residency a mandatory requirement for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. The applicant must be a resident of the Ward (urban area) or Gram Panchayat (rural area) where the vacant post is located.
